Apply the specific naval-supply rule, including the raider exception and cumulative capital-ship damage penalty.

capital_damage_resolution.exact_user_text: Its basically just -2 for each damage of the battleships, and -1 for carriers defending
capital_damage_resolution.applied_interpretation: Subtract 2 per damage point from Battleship and Heavy Battleship attack, defense and shore bombardment; subtract 1 per damage point from carrier defense. Movement is the separately printed flat -1 for damaged status; carrier aircraft capacity remains the unconditional printed capacity.
